project.name: QWERmix
project.summary: Champion creation, daily draft, team comp

about.text: Champion creation, daily draft, team comp

history.text: Earliest public web-archive capture we found

tests.scenario: G1 first-play flow: Daily Draft #38 without an account
tests.inputs: open /draft, reroll Top once (Cho'Gath->Skarner), Lock in
tests.expected: playable without account, rules visible on the page, one try per day
tests.actual: Dealt 5 champions, 3 rerolls (counter 3->2), lock-in returned Grade B 66/100 'Reads as: Pick' with sub-scores and reasons in about 3 s; no sign-in needed

tests.scenario: D3 five-champion comp grade, known engage comp
tests.inputs: Team Synergy: Malphite (Top), Amumu (Jungle), Orianna (Mid), Jinx (Bot), Leona (Support)
tests.expected: a hard-engage comp should be read as engage with frontline/CC strong and a magic-damage lean flagged
tests.actual: A 86/100, 'Hard engage', frontline 10.0, CC 10.0, engage 10.0, peel 3.3; 27% physical / 73% magic ('Damage leans magic'); combo note Orianna + Malphite;

tests.scenario: D5 role assignment / off-role handling with five marksmen (negative control)
tests.expected: a no-frontline all-AD team should grade poorly and off-role picks be noted
tests.actual: D 0/100, 'Reads as: Poke and siege', '5 marksmen. This team can't function.', 'Off-role: Caitlyn in top, Jhin in jungle', physical 100%, frontline 0.0;

tests.scenario: D1/D2 suggestion on a partial board
tests.inputs: SUGGEST PICKS with Malphite (Top) and Orianna (slot 2 = Jungle, flagged Off-role)
tests.expected: suggestions fill only empty lanes and state the resulting grade
tests.actual: 'Fill the empty lanes': Mid Karma, Bot Miss Fortune, Support Sett; 'Grades A (85/100), reads as hard engage'; ANOTHER SUGGESTION and USE THESE buttons

tests.scenario: G8 mobile spot check at 390 px, /draft
tests.inputs: resize to 390x844, reload, measure via DOM
tests.expected: no horizontal overflow; zoom not disabled
tests.actual: scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth; viewport meta width=device-width, initial-scale=1; 27 visible buttons/links, minimum dimension 17 px, 1 under 32 px
